target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Williamson occurrence/context is clear, but historical Travis material has repeatedly been re-determined among S. compositus, S. clandestinus, and S. compositus var. drummondii.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Local compositus-complex records are too taxonomically unstable to support 3 exact target-zone counties.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not count ambiguous historical varietal/specimen labels.

morphology.look_here_first: Treat this as a complex until the local concept is nailed down. Tall dropseed is a robust perennial with a tall narrow panicle, but Central Texas records historically mix S. compositus varieties with S. clandestinus.
diagnostic_traits: grain/pericarp and lemma characters may be needed
